details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:95,288 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The failure-reason serialization uses `|` as a delimiter, so a `detail` containing `|` is misparsed when read back.
  WHY: All reviewers agreed the write/read pair is fragile and will corrupt failure reporting if the detail text contains a pipe.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:89-95 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `fail_with_reason` writes `$detail` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` without sanitizing newlines.
  WHY: Newlines can break GitHub Actions output parsing, so multiline details can truncate or invalidate the output.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:140-160 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The sentinel `ai-update-workflows.yml` is skipped only on create, not on update, so an existing differing sentinel can be overwritten.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the missing update-path guard as a bootstrap-loop risk and a violation of the documented invariant.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:299,311 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The summary step exits `0` after reporting failures, masking the failed outcome.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this can make a failing workflow appear successful and mislead required checks.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:110-116 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The writability pre-check uses `[ -e "$local_file" ]`, which also matches directories.
  WHY: A directory at the target path would pass the check but still cause `cp` to fail; reviewers treated this as an edge-case robustness issue.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The tests rely on exact string containment checks against the workflow YAML.
  WHY: Formatting-only changes could break the tests even if behavior is unchanged.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The failure-reason temp file uses a predictable `/tmp` path.
  WHY: This was raised as a theoretical collision/race concern, but only one reviewer reported it and at low confidence.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `upstream_templates=( "${UPSTREAM_DIR}"/*.yml )` could benefit from `realpath` normalization.
  WHY: This was presented as a minor robustness improvement rather than a concrete bug.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:95,288 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Uses `|` as delimiter for failure reason serialization, making parsing fragile if detail contains `|`.
  WHY: If failure detail contains `|`, the `IFS='|' read` will split incorrectly, breaking failure reporting.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:140-146 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Sentinel `ai-update-workflows.yml` can be overwritten in update path when it already exists and differs upstream.
  WHY: This violates the documented invariant "never overwrite or auto-create it to avoid bootstrap loops".
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml (Summary step) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `exit 0` after detecting `FETCH_OUTCOME="failure"` or `UPDATE_OUTCOME="failure"`.
  WHY: The workflow appears successful when failure occurred, which is problematic if used as a required check.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:110-116 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Writability check `[ -e "$local_file" ]` can pass for directories, but `cp` will fail.
  WHY: Could cause unexpected failure when a directory exists at the target path.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml (`fail_with_reason` function) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `$detail` written to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` without sanitizing newlines.
  WHY: Newlines in detail could break GitHub Actions output parsing.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `upstream_templates=( "${UPSTREAM_DIR}"/*.yml )` could benefit from `realpath` normalization.
  WHY: Minor robustness improvement for edge cases.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Tests depend on exact string matches in workflow file.
  WHY: Formatting changes could break tests even if behavior stays correct.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:140-146 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code correctly skips the self-updater (sentinel) when creating new files, but it lacks an equivalent skip guard in the update block (lines 154-160).
  WHY: If the sentinel workflow exists locally but differs from the upstream template, it will be overwritten during the update pass. This violates the documented invariant that the self-updater must never be modified by itself to avoid bootstrap loops.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:95,288 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code uses a pipe `|` as a delimiter when writing to and reading from `/tmp/update_workflows_failure_reason.txt`.
  WHY: If the `detail` string contains a `|` character (which is common in error messages or paths), the `IFS='|' read` command in the Summary step will incorrectly split the string, leading to a truncated or corrupted failure detail in the GitHub Step Summary.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:301,312 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Summary step uses `exit 0` after detecting and reporting a failed outcome from previous steps.
  WHY: While this ensures the Step Summary is always rendered, it forces the job status to "success" even when a functional failure occurred, which can provide a false positive "pass" signal.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:89 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `fail_with_reason` function writes the `$detail` variable directly to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` without character validation or quoting.
  WHY: If the detail message contains newline characters, the runner may interpret it as multiple output lines and emit an "Unexpected format" error or truncate the value.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:110 (writability check loop) | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The check uses `[ -e "$local_file" ]` which returns true for directories.
  WHY: Use `[ -f "$local_file" ]` to ensure the target is a regular file before attempting a writability check.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:102 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The `upstream_templates` glob is evaluated against `${UPSTREAM_DIR}` directly.
  WHY: Use `UPSTREAM_DIR=$(realpath "${UPSTREAM_DIR}")` before globbing to ensure path resolution is robust against symbolic links or relative path segments.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code uses `|` as a delimiter between FAILURE_REASON_CODE and FAILURE_REASON_DETAIL.
  WHY: If the detail message ever contains a `|` character, the parsing will incorrectly split the string and corrupt the failure reason.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Summary step exits with code 0 after reporting failures.
  WHY: This masks failures and can make failed updates appear successful in CI dashboards or required checks.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The check to skip `ai-update-workflows.yml` exists only in the create path, not in the update path.
  WHY: If the sentinel file exists locally but differs from upstream, it will be overwritten, violating the self-updater invariant.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `fail_with_reason()` function uses `|` as a delimiter.
  WHY: If the `detail` string contains a pipe character, the `IFS='|' read` will split incorrectly and corrupt failure reporting.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In the Summary step, `exit 0` is used after failure detection.
  WHY: Because the step runs with `if: always()`, returning success after reporting a failure causes the job to report success even when the update failed.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sentinel skip logic exists only in the file creation path.
  WHY: The update path can overwrite an existing sentinel if upstream differs, violating the documented invariant.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The failure reason file uses a hardcoded predictable `/tmp` path.
  WHY: This was described as a theoretical collision risk if the workflow ever ran concurrently.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `fail_with_reason` writes `$detail` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` without sanitizing newlines, and the artifact file uses `|` as a delimiter.
  WHY: Multiline or pipe-containing details can corrupt GitHub Actions output parsing and/or failure-reason decoding.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Summary step relies on the fragile `|` delimiter when reading the stored failure reason.
  WHY: If the detail contains `|`, the split yields incorrect code/detail and hides the true error cause.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The sentinel skip guard exists only in the create branch; the update branch can still overwrite `ai-update-workflows.yml`.
  WHY: This violates the documented invariant and can trigger bootstrap loops or unexpected workflow behavior.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Summary step exits `0` after reporting a failed outcome for either fetch or update.
  WHY: That can mask failures in step outcome reporting and mislead downstream checks.
- tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The entire test module relies on exact string containment checks within the workflow YAML.
  WHY: Formatting-only changes can cause false negatives even when behavior is unchanged.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-file writability check uses `[ -e "$local_file" ] && [ ! -w "$local_file" ]`.
  WHY: `-e` matches directories, so a directory target can appear writable but still make `cp` fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
